gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

This PR adds a single bounded retry to the feed fetch, with tests that exercise it. It has no linked spec, so it is judged against its own description, and the code and tests match what that description promises; you are the author.

Merging is waiting on one thing: the required e2e check is still running on this head. Nothing needs fixing, and there are no PR comments, replies or smaller points to handle. Merge is not offered until e2e finishes green, and this gate watches checks only during delivery.

I recommend deliver because the running e2e check is the only thing holding up merge, and deliver will watch it through to a result.

Pick one:
1. deliver - watch the e2e check, rebase on main if the branch falls behind, repair anything that turns up, and continue until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. assess - post nothing because there are no problems to report, make no repairs, and end without watching the check.
3. stop - end the run and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
